findings.message: Nothing relates `s` (store_sales) to the join of `e` (events) and `u` (users), so every row of one pairs with every row of the other: how many isn't known, as the join of `e` (events) and `u` (users) may hold any number of rows. Bytes billed don't grow, but compute does, and counts or sums over the result are multiplied.
findings.fix: Add the condition that relates them. If every pair is intended, keep one side small, such as a single-row subquery or a short list of dates.
